description: This walk explores the Tarvin Community Woodland in the Cheshire village of Tarvin. The woods are located at the southern end of the village and includes a circular trail of just over a mile. The area includes woodland, meadow and wildflower areas with lots of wildlife to see. You could continue your walking by picking up the Baker Way and heading to Delamere Forest.
